patterns.note: Dominant use of a high-contrast, two-color palette (vibrant red and deep black) for a bold and impactful visual identity, with white used sparingly for text on dark backgrounds.
A subtle grid overlay is consistently used as a background element or structural guide across different full-screen sections.
Full-screen content transitions are used, where entire sections animate out to reveal completely new full-screen content, rather than simply scrolling to new sections.
The initial hero text and content animate upwards and scale down to integrate into a sticky header upon scroll, revealing a dynamic background.
A dynamic, canvas-rendered wavy line-art pattern animates into view as the primary hero background after the initial scroll.
Key messages and headings utilize an extremely bold, condensed display sans-serif font for maximum visual impact.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate complex, full-screen transitions. The initial hero content animates out of view while a dynamic canvas-rendered wavy background animates in. Further scrolling triggers a complete content swap to a new full-screen section with a grid overlay and a central call to action.
A canvas animation generates a fluid, wavy line-art pattern that serves as a visually engaging and dynamic background for the hero section.
Employs a stark two-color palette (vibrant red and deep black) to create a bold and impactful visual identity, with white used sparingly for contrast on dark backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, condensed display headings (~8x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif for navigation and body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero, with large negative space around key elements, transitioning to a more structured grid.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extreme high-contrast color, combined with full-screen, almost theatrical motion transitions and a dynamic canvas-rendered hero background, creates a highly memorable and immersive experience that feels more like an interactive art piece than a typical portfolio. The bold, almost brutalist typography further reinforces this unique aesthetic.
